name: compact batches preserve FIFO admission and output positions
input: three requests with different completion lengths and two active slots
test:
class IncrementLastTokenModel:
    def next_tokens(self, prefixes):
        return [prefix[-1] + 1 for prefix in prefixes]

results = []
engine = DynamicBatchInference(IncrementLastTokenModel(), batch_size=2, stop_token=99)
engine.submit([10], 1, results.append)
engine.submit([20], 3, results.append)
engine.submit([30], 2, results.append)
engine.run()
assert results == [[10, 11], [20, 21, 22, 23], [30, 31, 32]]

name: zero budgets and stop sequences complete exactly once
input: one zero-budget request, one prompt-tail stop, and one generated multi-token stop
test:
class SequenceModel:
    def __init__(self):
        self.tokens = iter([7, 8])
    def next_tokens(self, prefixes):
        return [next(self.tokens) for _ in prefixes]

results = []
engine = DynamicBatchInference(SequenceModel(), batch_size=1, stop_token=99)
engine.submit([1], 0, results.append)
engine.submit([3, 4], 5, results.append, stop_sequences=[[3, 4]])
engine.submit([5], 8, results.append, stop_sequences=[[7, 8]])
engine.run()
assert results == [[1], [3, 4], [5, 7, 8]]

name: padded batches keep a stable slot-to-output mapping
input: three requests with two slots and a separate one-request padded batch
test:
class PaddedModel:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
    def next_tokens_padded(self, prefixes, active_mask):
        self.calls.append(([list(prefix) for prefix in prefixes], list(active_mask)))
        return [prefix[-1] + 100 if active else -999 for prefix, active in zip(prefixes, active_mask)]

model = PaddedModel()
results = []
engine = DynamicBatchInference(model, batch_size=2, stop_token=99)
engine.submit([1], 1, results.append)
engine.submit([10], 3, results.append)
engine.submit([20], 2, results.append)
engine.run_padded()
assert sorted(results) == sorted([[1, 101], [10, 110, 210, 310], [20, 120, 220]])

probe = PaddedModel()
only = []
engine = DynamicBatchInference(probe, batch_size=3, stop_token=99)
engine.submit([5], 2, only.append)
engine.run_padded()
assert only == [[5, 105, 205]]
assert probe.calls[0] == ([[5], [], []], [True, False, False])
assert probe.calls[1] == ([[5, 105], [], []], [True, False, False])
